_comment: Import map for the Supabase Edge Functions in this directory.
These run on Deno, not in the browser, so they are excluded from the app's
tsconfig.json. Pinning the dependencies here means `deno check` can verify
them locally — before this file they had no type checking at all.
npm: specifiers are used rather than esm.sh URLs so versions resolve from
one place and match what the Edge Runtime installs.
